Package com.wac.autocore.exception

  • Exception Summary 
    Exception Description
    AppException
    The parent of the app's own errors, so a caller can catch them in one place.
    DataAccessException
    The database did not answer.
    DatabaseInitException
    The database could not be prepared, and then nothing else in the app can work.
    DuplicateRegistrationNumberException
    The registration number already belongs to another vehicle.
    MechanicUnavailableException
    The mechanic is already booked for that time.
    NotFoundException
    A row the caller asked for is not there.
    RuleViolationException
    The action is not allowed in the state the row is in.
    ValidationException
    A value that cannot be stored.
